item.title: Sudden Blurry Vision In One Eye: When To Take It Seriously; Explained
item.description: Sudden blurry vision in one eye can signal serious health issues ranging from eye infections to stroke. Experts say ignoring sudden vision changes may lead to permanent damage. Here are the possible causes and warning signs you should know.

item.title: Weather Update Today: Delhi-NCR to See Rising Heat Until Holi, Light Rain on Feb 28
item.description: According to the IMD, temperatures in Delhi-NCR will steadily rise from February 25 to March 2. Maximum temperatures are expected to reach 33–34°C, and night temperatures may reach 17°C. Light rain is expected in some areas on February 28 due to the impact of a Western Disturbance.

item.title: Gold and Silver prices drop amid dollar rise and market uncertainty
item.description: Gold and silver prices continue to fluctuate in the international and domestic markets. Amid a strengthening dollar and global tensions, investors have accelerated profit-booking. Long-term price gains are expected.

item.title: Stock Market Update: Indian stock market opens higher, with the Sensex at 82,784 and the Nifty at 25,581
item.description: The Indian stock market opened higher on February 25, 2026. The Sensex rose 558 points to 82,784, and the Nifty rose 157 points to 25,581. The market had seen a significant decline on February 24th.

item.title: “Pakistan PM would’ve died if it were not for my involvement,” claims US President Donald Trump
item.description: US President Donald Trump stated in his State of the Union address that he played a key role in averting a potential war between India and Pakistan, but India completely rejected this claim.

item.title: Gold-Silver Rate Today: Gold prices rise, 24-carat gold reaches ₹161,940 per 10 grams in Delhi; silver prices fall
item.description: On the morning of February 25, 2026, the price of 24-carat gold in Delhi reached ₹161,940 per 10 grams. Silver prices fell to ₹284,900 per kilogram. The rupee's weakness and domestic demand pushed up gold prices.

item.title: Delhi Horror: Woman and three children brutally murdered in broad daylight, suspect still at large
item.description: In Delhi’s Timarpur Badli, a woman and her three children were brutally murdered with a sharp weapon in Chandan Park. The suspect is absconding, while police investigate the scene, collect evidence, and question local residents.

item.title: Ashutosh Brahmachari says ‘no one can save Avimukteshwaranand from Jail’ over sexual abuse case
item.description: Ashutosh Brahmachari publicly stated that he has “strong evidence” which, he claims, will ensure the accused are sent to jail. He also rejected a viral photograph that allegedly shows him with a police officer, asserting that the image is fake and was created using Artificial Intelligence (AI).

item.title: “No greater patriotism than defending the weak,” says Rahul Gandhi about Mohammad Deepak
item.description: Deepak Kumar of Kotdwar, who intervened during a protest by Bajrang Dal against a Muslim shopkeeper, met Rahul Gandhi, who praised his courage, highlighting his defense of the Constitution and the tricolor.
